derived_from.source_inventory_scope: Frozen R5 root source checksums copied without modifying R5.

hypothesis_change.change: Split the same two P-to-D semantic requests into serial P0 then P1 and concurrent P0 plus P1 phases. Each phase has a distinct receipt directory and run token. The request content is unchanged between phases.
hypothesis_change.reason: Both concurrently launched semantic requests in 224277 failed with NIXL sender or remote-disconnect errors after metadata/source gates passed. This diagnostic distinguishes serial initialization from follow-on concurrency within one worker lifetime.

gate_change.change: Replay serial and concurrent receipt sets independently, then require both sets in the final gate. Keep 16 metadata receipts, six loaded module reports, and native send invocation/outcome checks.
gate_change.limit: A returned transfer handle is not proof of completion; no transport root-cause claim is made.

observability_correction.reason: R5 worker.sh invoked this helper but the frozen R5 bundle did not contain it; R5 locality logs captured the file-open failure. This restores the already intended role-locality observation without changing model or transport behavior.
observability_correction.causal_limit: PBS does not pin the future R6 allocation to the same pair; this diagnostic contrasts phases within one allocation and cannot attribute cross-job changes to hardware nodes.
